protocol.sampling: 1:1 real/synthetic with replacement; same step-indexed batches and augmentation seed
protocol.objective: supervised pose MSE only; no new domain classifier/adversarial training
protocol.precision: FP32, TF32 off, deterministic; same device for all tests
protocol.evaluation: original Test100 GT boxes, DarkPose decoder, batch16; flip on except noflip test
protocol.selection: fixed 600-step final checkpoints only; no Test100 early stopping or adaptive search
protocol.limitation: exploratory single-seed comparisons; released checkpoint may have prior training/Test100 overlap

paired_forward_benchmark.scope: CNN forward only, device-resident inputs, warmed; excludes preprocessing, transfer, flip-back and decoding
